title: Nvidia’s AI Servers Are About to Get Even More Expensive as Rising Memory Costs Push Prices Up More Than 15%: Report

Some Nvidia Corp customers have reportedly been informed that prices for servers equipped with its AI chips could increase by more than 15%.

Nvidia AI Server Prices Could Rise 15% or More

This price increase is expected to apply to systems shipped in early 2027 and affect servers powered by Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell platforms, among others, Bloomberg reported Sunday, citing people familiar with the process.

The hike will depend on Nvidia chip generation and memory configuration, the report said.

Server companies that build systems for major data center operators, including Microsoft Corp, Alphabet Inc.'s Google and Oracle Corp, have reportedly informed customers about the upcoming price hike.

Nvidia did not immediately respond to Benzinga's request for comment.

Soaring Memory Costs Drive AI Infrastructure Bills Higher

The reported price increases come as demand for memory chips continues to surge.

Memory makers like Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix Inc – ADR and Micron Technology, Inc. have gained greater pricing power as AI infrastructure spending strains supply.

Trending: Avoid the #1 Investing Mistake: How Your 'Safe' Holdings Could Be Costing You Big Time

Tech giants like Apple Inc. and Qualcomm Inc. have also raised or announced plans to raise prices because of surging memory costs and supply chain constraints due to the ongoing chip shortage.

NVDA Earnings in Focus

The development comes as Nvidia prepares to report its second-quarter results on Aug. 26. 

According to Benzinga data, analysts expect Nvidia's revenue to jump 96% to $92 billion. Meanwhile, third-quarter guidance is projected to reach $103 billion.

Building Wealth Across More Than Just the Market

Building a resilient portfolio means thinking beyond a single asset or market trend. Economic cycles shift, sectors rise and fall, and no one investment performs well in every environment. That's why many investors look to diversify with platforms that provide access to real estate, fixed-income opportunities, precious metals, and even self-directed retirement accounts. By spreading exposure across multiple asset classes, it becomes easier to manage risk, capture steady returns, and create long-term wealth that isn't tied to the fortunes of just one company or industry.

不仅仅在市场上创造财富

建立有弹性的投资组合意味着超越单一资产或市场趋势的思维。 经济周期发生变化，行业兴衰，没有一项投资在所有环境下都能表现良好。 这就是为什么许多投资者希望通过提供房地产、固定收益机会、贵金属甚至自我管理退休账户的平台来实现多元化。 通过将风险分散到多个资产类别，可以更轻松地管理风险、获得稳定的回报并创造不只与一家公司或行业的命运挂钩的长期财富。
